content.value_statement: AI search engines often cite content that is structured, current, and easy to extract. This skill guides audits, content patterns, and machine-readable files for better AI visibility.
actual_capabilities: Audit AI visibility across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude, Gemini, and Copilot.
Map priority queries to citation status, competitor citations, and content gaps.
Recommend extractable content blocks, FAQ sections, comparison tables, and schema markup.
Explain when to use llms.txt, pricing files, and Open Knowledge Format bundles.
Guide robots.txt checks for major AI crawlers and search bots.
Suggest monitoring workflows for AI citation rate, sentiment, and source attribution.
limitations: It does not guarantee citations or ranking changes from any AI search platform.
It relies on user-provided queries, site details, and accessible content.
It does not replace technical SEO audits, schema implementation, or analytics tools.
Platform behavior changes often, so recommendations need periodic review.

use_cases.title: Audit AI Visibility
use_cases.description: Audit why a site is missing from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI answers. Prioritize fixes by query value.

use_cases.title: Improve Content Extractability
use_cases.description: Turn existing pages into clear answer blocks, comparison tables, FAQ sections, and cited claims. Keep the page useful for people.

use_cases.title: Prepare Agent-Readable Pages
use_cases.description: Create public pricing, llms.txt, and OKF guidance so agents can evaluate products without hidden context.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Basic Visibility Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner audit for known priority queries.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my AI search visibility for these queries: [queries]. Tell me where my brand appears, where competitors appear, and what to fix first.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of an existing page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page for AI citation readiness: [URL or text]. Identify weak answer blocks, missing sources, schema gaps, and crawler access issues.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Multi-Platform AI SEO
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced strategy for a site or product line.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an AI SEO plan for [site] across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Copilot. Include query clusters, content formats, and monitoring metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Benchmark Competitors
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced competitive analysis for market positioning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare our AI visibility against [competitors] for [queries]. Create a prioritized roadmap for content structure, third-party presence, llms.txt, OKF, and measurement.

output_examples.input: User asks for an AI visibility audit for ten buyer queries.
output: A platform-by-platform citation table shows where the brand, competitors, and third-party sources appear.
Priority fixes include adding sourced statistics, clearer definitions, FAQ schema, and AI bot access checks.
A monthly monitoring plan tracks citation rate, sentiment, and pages cited by each platform.

output_examples.input: User provides a product page that is not cited by AI answers.
output: The page review highlights buried definitions, weak source attribution, and missing buyer questions.
The revised outline adds a direct answer, comparison section, transparent pricing, and FAQ structure.
The next steps separate quick copy fixes from schema and crawler access work.

output_examples.input: User wants machine-readable files for an AI agent buying journey.
output: The recommendation explains which details belong in public pricing and llms.txt files.
The OKF guidance describes when a bundle is worth the extra maintenance.
The plan keeps human pages primary and treats agent-readable files as supporting material.

best_practices: Start with the queries that affect revenue, support demand, or product discovery.
Use human-readable content first, then add machine-readable files where they help.
Recheck citations monthly because AI answers and source choices can change.
anti_patterns: Writing separate pages only for AI crawlers instead of useful human content.
Fabricating reviews, citations, or community mentions to influence AI answers.
Blocking important AI search bots while expecting those platforms to cite the site.

faq.question: What is AI SEO?
faq.answer: AI SEO structures content so AI search tools can find, understand, and cite it. It builds on normal SEO foundations.

faq.question: Does this replace traditional SEO?
faq.answer: No. It adds citation-focused structure, source clarity, and AI crawler access checks to standard SEO work.

faq.question: Which platforms does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, and related AI search experiences.

faq.question: Can it create llms.txt or OKF guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains when these files help and what information they should include for AI agents.

faq.question: Does it guarantee AI citations?
faq.answer: No. It improves citation readiness, but platforms choose sources through private ranking and retrieval systems.

faq.question: Is it useful with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. Claude Code and Codex can use the skill to audit repository content and suggest AI-readable improvements.
